note: Copyright Footer ships a single Block plugin (id copyright_footer) that renders 'Copyright © <year> <organization> <version>' with the current year computed on every build. There is no settings page and no configure route (configure=null); all configuration lives on the placed block instance under block.block.<id>.settings, validated by schema block.settings.copyright_footer with keys organization_name, organization_url, year_origin, year_to_date, version, version_url. Medium cases place a block with a known config for the agent to read back; hard cases require the agent to place and configure a block, verified against live block config.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module copyright_footer, what does it add to the site and how does the copyright year stay current without an editor updating it every year?
evals.expected_output: It provides a single Block plugin (id copyright_footer) that renders a 'Copyright © <year> <organization> <version>' notice. The year is recomputed with PHP \DateTime on every build(), so the current year is always shown automatically.

evals.prompt: I enabled copyright_footer on Drupal 11 but I cannot find an admin configuration page for it. How do I actually set the organization name and where is that value stored?
evals.expected_output: There is no settings page and configure=null. You place the 'Copyright Footer' block via Structure > Block layout (Place block) and set organization_name (and the other keys) in the block's own configuration form. It is stored on the block config entity at block.block.<id>.settings.organization_name (schema block.settings.copyright_footer).

evals.prompt: Using copyright_footer, which block settings control whether the footer shows a single year versus a year range like 2010-2026, and what happens if I leave the end year blank?
evals.expected_output: year_origin and year_to_date control it. If year_origin is empty or equals the current year you get a single year; otherwise you get year_origin-year_to_date. If year_to_date is left blank it falls back to the current year.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site already has a Copyright Footer block placed (block config id cf_known). Inspect its live configuration and tell me the organization name it is configured to display.
evals.expected_output: The organization name is 'Acme Widgets Ltd', stored at block.block.cf_known -> settings.organization_name.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Copyright Footer block (block config id cf_range) configured to show a year range. Inspect its live configuration and state the start year (year origin) it uses.
evals.expected_output: The start year is 2011, stored at block.block.cf_range -> settings.year_origin.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the copyright_footer module to place a Copyright Footer block in the footer of the default theme. Give the block the machine name (config id) cf_task and configure its organization name to be 'Copyright Test Org'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A block config entity block.block.cf_task exists with plugin 'copyright_footer' and settings.organization_name == 'Copyright Test Org'.

evals.prompt: Place a Copyright Footer block on this Drupal site (config id cf_range_task) that displays a copyright year range beginning in 2005 (so the footer reads like 'Copyright © 2005-<current year> ...'). Apply the change to the live default form/site configuration.
evals.expected_output: A block config entity block.block.cf_range_task exists with plugin 'copyright_footer' and settings.year_origin == 2005, so build() renders a 2005-<current year> range.
